summary.headline: Backend engineer building production Python services and LLM-backed product features
summary.description: Senior backend engineer with nine years of experience designing APIs, data pipelines, and search-backed products. Recent work has been taking retrieval and agent workflows from prototype into monitored production systems: FastAPI services, hybrid search, structured LLM outputs, and cost controls so model spend stays predictable. Comfortable owning a slice of a product end to end, from schema design through deployment and on-call.

keyDifferentiators.description: Designed hybrid OpenSearch/BM25 plus kNN retrieval and the MongoDB document model behind a high-volume job-matching feed.

keyDifferentiators.title: Small-team ownership
keyDifferentiators.description: Used to being the person who can take a backend from design through CI, container packaging, and a production incident without a dedicated platform team.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Owned the Python services that collect, deduplicate, and score job postings for an internal talent product used daily by recruiters.
Introduced a two-stage LLM gate (cheap screen, then full fit assessment) and hybrid OpenSearch retrieval so assessment spend scaled with match quality rather than corpus size.
Built authenticated FastAPI endpoints for the job feed, manual job submit, and cover-letter generation, including start-and-poll background tasks.
Instrumented agents with Prometheus token and estimated-cost metrics and traced pipeline cycles with OpenTelemetry.
experience.companyDescription: Berlin product studio building recruiting and talent-matching tools for European SMEs.
experience.impact: Cut full-assessment LLM volume on each collection cycle by retrieving a ratio of the batch instead of scoring every pair, while keeping high-fit roles in the recruiter feed.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
responsibilities: Built event-driven document ingestion for logistics invoices: S3 landing, normalisation workers, and a PostgreSQL reporting schema.
Designed REST APIs consumed by a React operations console, with JWT auth and per-tenant isolation.
Operated the service in production, including on-call rotations and post-incident write-ups.
experience.companyDescription: Amsterdam B2B platform for freight documentation and billing.
experience.impact: Reduced median invoice-to-ledger time from overnight batch to under fifteen minutes for the core customer set.
